    {
      if ( *(_QWORD *)i != 0 )
      {
        v4 = *(PVOID **)(*(_QWORD *)i + 32LL);
        if ( *v4 != nullptr )
        {
          v2 = DecodePointer(*v4);
          (*(void (__fastcall **)(PVOID))(*(_QWORD *)v2 + 16LL))(v2);
          *v4 = nullptr;
        }
      }
    }
    DeleteCriticalSection((LPCRITICAL_SECTION)(a1 + 32));
    *(_DWORD *)a1 = 0;
    return a1;
  }
  return result;
}
// ENDFUNC
// FUNC 180062640 DecodePointer
// attributes: thunk

{
  return __imp_DecodePointer(Ptr);
}
